book.title: MAK Kamambuno wakai Mak muno boglkwa

content: Yesus i Pailat moglmara eingwa

Tangina kinde kaima pris kande wagle ya, yomba mina ende okuna eingwa ya te lo beke teingwa yomba ya, kaunsol prapra makai sindre ana ye eraglmere oglandi ka dikeglkwa. Ye eremogl Yesus kanesi pandigl ana auro ipi Pailat Rom yagl kande orkwa ongo mina yeingwa.
Ana Pailat krapogl tongwa, “Ene Juda yomba kingno motno?” Yesus di ikine endungwa, “Enene yegl dinga.”
Ana pris kande wagle ka merkinde di Yesus nangiye dangingwa.
Yeglpre Pailat aglke krapogl Yesus tongwa, “Ene ka dingwa i ta di ikine ende tekratno? Kanno, ye ka merkinde di nangin dangingwa i pitno?”
Ba Yesus ama ka suwara kaima ta di ikine endekruko, ana Pailat kundugl goglkwa.
Pailat eremogl Yesus sigolo di te koglo endungwa
Pasova mokna bir neingwa enge kande yongo ana ye okuna mambunono yegl pangwa. Kane paingwa suwarata yomba ye kangiye daiglko, ana Pailat poko ende-ende orkwa.
Enge igle yagl ta kangiye Barabas we dingwa, ye okuna yongo yomba tau bogl gavman kunda bogl tendre yomba sigeglkwa pre ana ye kane yungu suna akiye paingwa.
Enge igle yomba merkinde ende wu makai sindre ana mambuno bogl Pailat krapogl teingwa. Ye okuna enge ta yongo ere tomere ikra ero dingwa.
Ana Pailat krapogl tongwa, “Ene Juda yomba kingno i kane poko ende norambedi ene pirmo?”
Pailat pirkan ere kondingwa. Pris kande wagle mirmogl tendre Yesus kanesi ye teingwa.
Ba pris kande wagle yomba merkinde di nusingwa, i ye Pailat krapogl tembi ana ye eremogl Yesus kane poko endinambere i kondo ana Barabas kane poko ye mina endinambuka.
Ana Pailat aglke yomba krapogl tongwa, “Ana ene Juda yomba kingno we dingwa yagle i na sragl ere tenambedi pirme?”
Ye muglkumdi di ikine endingwa, “Ye endi-prak mina siyo.”
Ana Pailat krapoglkwa, “Sraglpre? Ye sragl tandaglme orum?” Ba ye prapra kaglkane binan bogl kaima indre dingwa, “Ye endi-prak mina siyo!”
Ana Pailat prukwa yomba merkinde gun yenaglmedi pre, ana Barabas kane poko ye mina endungwa. Te ye dungo kimbirnem Yesus kumba wip
singo ana ye endi-prak mina sinaglkwa pre tekoglo endungwa.
Kimbirnem Yesus bakagl teingwa
Kimbirnem Yesus auro ipi gavman yungu kande Pretorim we dimara pindre ana ye kongun akiye erikwa prapra aglendi makai singwa.
Ye gagl suna olto kum endungwa ta Yesus ende tendre ana kewan kangigle orkwa yongagle ake kumbro mawasi king bre gagl mereyegl ere, ana bre mina pandigl teingwa.
Ana ye mambuno bogl bakagl teingwa, “Etne wakai, Juda yomba kingno!”
Ye bre mina kumba aglke aglke sindre ana eur si nangiye mina endingwa. Te goglkuno bondugl ana bitno mangidi teingwa.
Ana ye okuna kana Yesus bakagl tekondo, ye gagl kum endungwa gugl ikine ende ana yene gaglmo ende ikine ende tendre, okuwo Yesus endi-prak mina sinaglkwa pre auro imenda eingwa.
Yesus endi-prak mina singwa

Konbo bange yagl suwarata tengigl yeingwa, kangiye Saimon, ye Sairini kamun nem. Ye Aleksanda ya Rufus neno, ye ende dumo kande suna enagledi pre wongo ana Yesus endimo-prak kake yenambedi pre kimbirnem ake nusingwa.
Ye Yesus auro yendpi kamun ta kangiye Golgata we dimara eingwa. (I mambuno yegl, bitno yombuglo kamun.)
Ana igle ye nigl giu orkwa toindi wain mina suna sikugl ende Yesus teingwa. Ba ye nekrukwa.
Ana Yesus endi-prak mina si pandigl ana gaglmo prapra ye yene yumbu sindre, ana srambre ere suwara suwarandi inaglkwa ipre satu singwa.
Ana ye tangina kinde kana enge i 9 klok Yesus endi-prak mina singwa.
Ana ka di nangiye dange kot ere teingwa kamo ikra muno beglkwa, “Ye Juda Yomba Kingno.”
Ana kimbirnem ombugl kunogl gogl nembrika yagl suwo Yesus bogl akiye endi-prak mina singwa. Ta ye ongo wokra pango ana ta ongo kondakra pangwa.
I Kamambuno mina muno beglkwa pamere mere wu geundungwa. Ye kunogl gogl yomba bogl i-suwara endingwa.
Yomba konbauna wu ikine ikine pi ana bitno piya sindre Yesus bakaglte dingwa, “Aya, ene God holi yungumo sigurndindre, ana ande enge suwota mina kordagl kei ikine endinatngra.
Yeglpre erme endi-prak mina ende atne undre ana enene ere yo!”
Kuno yegl keunde pris kande wagle ya te lo beke teingwa yomba, Yesus bakagl tendre ana yene di imboriya ende dingwa, “Ye yomba tau ere-yungwa, ba ye yene ere-inambuka manga!
Nono kan mouno, Mesaia, i Israel yomba Kingno, ye endi-prak mina erme ende atne unan ana nono kandre ye pirngi dinamga.” Ana yagl suwo endi-prak mina Yesus bogl akiye singwa, i ama kenaglmo simbrika.
Yesus goglkwa
Ana ande kuiya 12 klok orko, makan koglkoglo mim waidi were kondungo pai endpi ande kuiya 3 klok orkwa.
Ana ande kuiya 3 klok mina Yesus kaglkane binan bogl orkwa, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” I mambuno yegl, “Na Godna, na Godna, sraglpre ene na kinde kondine?”
Enge i yomba tau magl igle andigl meglkwa, ye Yesus dungwa i pirtre ye dingwa, “Piryo, ye Elaija pre agle dungwa.”

Ana yagl suwarata mukundi ende pindre ana giangin ta indre wain geu orkwa simbai buglo muglo mina bogl pandigl, Yesus bindi ninambedi pre tendre ana dungwa, “Erme ye kan winge eriyo, Elaija undre ye endi-prak mina i-atne endinan kanamna.”
Ana Yesus kaglkane pond indre mur iyenda ende gokandi goglkwa.
Ana God holi yungumo mina gagl alap olto keglkwa i mitna imbo yei arglandi endpi punduno poriya si wu koglkoglo ongwa.

Ana enge igle kimbirnem ende okuna ongwa yagle, Yesus endi-prak mina pamara gumamugl igle andigl mogltre ana Yesus kaglkane yungo pirtre, te sraglmere ere goglkwa i kandre, dungwa, “Kaima, yagl i God Wam moglkwa.”
Igle ambu tau eglke dagl mogl kanmeglkwa. Meglmara suna igle Makdala kamun mam Maria ya, te Maria, Jems yagl gakmugl ya Joses mano ya, te Salume.
Ambumo i okuna ye Galili dumo suna Yesus omara pindre akepledi te-te erikwa. Te ambu tau mere Yesus bogl akiye ende Jerusalem wingwa ye ama akiye meglkwa.
Yesus nangiye ipi maugl singwa
Tangina Sabat yenambuka enge magl ungwa, yeglpre ana erme akekun eraglkwa ande gungutndi ake namdungwa.

Ana Josep Arimatia kamun nem, ye kaunsol yomba kande meglmara yagl wakai mogl gumamugl endungwa yagle ye ungwa. Ye ama God kingdomo pre sugl moglkwa yagle ye kundugl goglkre ana Pailat moglmara pindre, Yesus nangiye ina pre krapoglkwa.
Ana Pailat prukwa Yesus kande goglme dingo pirtre, ye wai kuglkwa. Ana kimbirnem ende okuna ongwa yagl agle dindre krapogl tongwa, “Yesus kaima goglmo?”
Enge igle kimbirnem ende okuna ongwa yagle dungo Pailat prukwa kaima orko ana pra wedi, Yesus nangiye Josep yo dungwa.

Yeglpre Josep gagl alap kruwo kor ta topo ere indre ana Yesus nangiye endi-prak mina i atne ende, gagl alap yombugl tendre ana kombuglo dra yomba geglko pandiglmara ta waugl yeimara sunakra yongwa. Ana ye kombuglo kande ta egla pagl ipi dramugl sipegl dungwa.
Ana Makdala kamun mam Maria ya te Joses mam Maria, ye kanmogl Yesus nangiye pandiglmara dumo igle kanbrika.

footnotes.text: Kumba wip i yegl: Kan kumba akimara endi pangwa punduwomugl kau nangiye tonguma singwa i ana yomba ere si-si erikwa.
Erme pirpogl singwa yomba tau pirkwa, epigl i Mak muno boglkrukwa. Ana okuwo yomba ta boglme dingwa.
